display.title: A Zaidy's Message: Why I Moved to Eretz Yisroel
display.summary_short: A grandfather explains why, after sixty years of work in America, he moved to Eretz Yisroel, and tells of the free-loan fund he opened there; followed by singing.
display.summary_long: A family recording. A grandfather answers friends who asked why he is moving to Eretz Yisroel: for sixty years he worked in America for his body, to raise good, religious children, and now it is time to go to the Holy Land and work for his soul by doing its many mitzvos. He proudly tells that he has opened a family gemach, a free-loan fund, with his own donation, which already gives interest-free loans to poor families and struggling businessmen. He hopes, with Hashem's help, that all his children will soon move to Eretz Yisroel too, and promises to help them settle. The short talk is followed by several minutes of his singing, which is not transcribed.
display.lesson: After a lifetime of raising a Torah family, a person can devote his later years to his soul, to Eretz Yisroel and to helping others through gemilus chasadim.
